title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-05-29 SGA record with SGA 5 strict restart through Expose III B Proposition 4.2
description:
Working public SGA archive for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The record combines existing English translation snapshots, current working translation readers, French reference PDFs, and source artifacts for continued checking.

Status at a glance. [#####-----] corpus-wide working translation material is present. Top-level readers include SGA 1-2 English snapshots, a cleaned SGA 3 English rebuild, SGA 4 as the largest current working reader, active SGA 5-7 partial assemblies, and French reference PDFs for SGA 1-7. The current SGA 5 high-fidelity restart is paired French/English and runs through Expose III B Proposition 4.2, ending after the proof of 2.5 and 1.2.

The artifact ZIP preserves TeX sources, compile logs, source scan slices, render checks, prior segment packets, and provenance notes. These are working scholarly editions and translations, not proofed critical editions.
notes: Latest update promotes the SGA 5 strict restart through Expose III B Proposition 4.2 and preserves previous strict-reader material inside the artifact ZIP.
